name: 用Swift脚本测出WearfitBLEError各case对应的NSError code数值

text:
请在 macOS 上执行一个 Swift 脚本，用来确定一个 Swift enum 在自动桥接为 NSError 时,每个 case 实际对应的整数 code 值。

请把下面内容写入一个临时文件 `/tmp/error_probe.swift`：

```swift
import Foundation

enum WearfitBLEError: Error, Equatable, Sendable {
    case bluetoothUnavailable
    case scanTimedOut
    case connectTimedOut
    case pairingRequired
    case serviceDiscoveryFailed
    case characteristicDiscoveryFailed
    case notifySetupFailed
    case writeFailed
    case commandTimedOut(command: UInt8?)
    case disconnectedDuringCommand
    case connectionSuperseded
    case reconnectCoolingDown
    case invalidAdvertisement
    case invalidResponse
    case deviceNotFound
    case notConnected
    case unsupported
    case permissionDeniedMessage(String)
    case bluetoothUnavailableMessage(String)
    case scanTimeoutMessage(String)
    case deviceNotFoundMessage(String)
    case connectTimeoutMessage(String)
    case serviceNotFoundMessage(String)
    case writeFailedMessage(String)
    case notifyFailedMessage(String)
    case commandTimeoutMessage(String)
    case protocolInvalidMessage(String)
    case deviceRejectedMessage(String)
    case transferFailedMessage(String)
    case deviceAuthFailedMessage(String)
    case vendorFailedMessage(String)
    case cancelledMessage(String)
}

let cases: [(String, WearfitBLEError)] = [
    ("bluetoothUnavailable", .bluetoothUnavailable),
    ("scanTimedOut", .scanTimedOut),
    ("connectTimedOut", .connectTimedOut),
    ("pairingRequired", .pairingRequired),
    ("serviceDiscoveryFailed", .serviceDiscoveryFailed),
    ("characteristicDiscoveryFailed", .characteristicDiscoveryFailed),
    ("notifySetupFailed", .notifySetupFailed),
    ("writeFailed", .writeFailed),
    ("commandTimedOut(nil)", .commandTimedOut(command: nil)),
    ("disconnectedDuringCommand", .disconnectedDuringCommand),
    ("connectionSuperseded", .connectionSuperseded),
    ("reconnectCoolingDown", .reconnectCoolingDown),
    ("invalidAdvertisement", .invalidAdvertisement),
    ("invalidResponse", .invalidResponse),
    ("deviceNotFound", .deviceNotFound),
    ("notConnected", .notConnected),
    ("unsupported", .unsupported),
    ("permissionDeniedMessage", .permissionDeniedMessage("x")),
    ("bluetoothUnavailableMessage", .bluetoothUnavailableMessage("x")),
    ("scanTimeoutMessage", .scanTimeoutMessage("x")),
    ("deviceNotFoundMessage", .deviceNotFoundMessage("x")),
    ("connectTimeoutMessage", .connectTimeoutMessage("x")),
    ("serviceNotFoundMessage", .serviceNotFoundMessage("x")),
    ("writeFailedMessage", .writeFailedMessage("x")),
    ("notifyFailedMessage", .notifyFailedMessage("x")),
    ("commandTimeoutMessage", .commandTimeoutMessage("x")),
    ("protocolInvalidMessage", .protocolInvalidMessage("x")),
    ("deviceRejectedMessage", .deviceRejectedMessage("x")),
    ("transferFailedMessage", .transferFailedMessage("x")),
    ("deviceAuthFailedMessage", .deviceAuthFailedMessage("x")),
    ("vendorFailedMessage", .vendorFailedMessage("x")),
    ("cancelledMessage", .cancelledMessage("x")),
]

for (name, err) in cases {
    let ns = err as NSError
    print("\(ns.code)\t\(name)\t\(ns.domain)")
}
```

然后执行：

```
swift /tmp/error_probe.swift
```

如果系统上 `swift` 命令不可用，改用：

```
xcrun swift /tmp/error_probe.swift
```

把完整输出（每一行的 code、case 名字、domain）原样返回给我，尤其告诉我哪个 case 对应的 code 正好是 18。

`swift` 命令可用，脚本执行成功。完整输出如下（格式：code、case 名字、domain）：

```
16	bluetoothUnavailable	error_probe.WearfitBLEError
17	scanTimedOut	error_probe.WearfitBLEError
18	connectTimedOut	error_probe.WearfitBLEError
19	pairingRequired	error_probe.WearfitBLEError
20	serviceDiscoveryFailed	error_probe.WearfitBLEError
21	characteristicDiscoveryFailed	error_probe.WearfitBLEError
22	notifySetupFailed	error_probe.WearfitBLEError
23	writeFailed	error_probe.WearfitBLEError
0	commandTimedOut(nil)	error_probe.WearfitBLEError
24	disconnectedDuringCommand	error_probe.WearfitBLEError
25	connectionSuperseded	error_probe.WearfitBLEError
26	reconnectCoolingDown	error_probe.WearfitBLEError
27	invalidAdvertisement	error_probe.WearfitBLEError
28	invalidResponse	error_probe.WearfitBLEError
29	deviceNotFound	error_probe.WearfitBLEError
30	notConnected	error_probe.WearfitBLEError
31	unsupported	error_probe.WearfitBLEError
1	permissionDeniedMessage	error_probe.WearfitBLEError
2	bluetoothUnavailableMessage	error_probe.WearfitBLEError
3	scanTimeoutMessage	error_probe.WearfitBLEError
4	deviceNotFoundMessage	error_probe.WearfitBLEError
5	connectTimeoutMessage	error_probe.WearfitBLEError
6	serviceNotFoundMessage	error_probe.WearfitBLEError
7	writeFailedMessage	error_probe.WearfitBLEError
8	notifyFailedMessage	error_probe.WearfitBLEError
9	commandTimeoutMessage	error_probe.WearfitBLEError
10	protocolInvalidMessage	error_probe.WearfitBLEError
11	deviceRejectedMessage	error_probe.WearfitBLEError
12	transferFailedMessage	error_probe.WearfitBLEError
13	deviceAuthFailedMessage	error_probe.WearfitBLEError
14	vendorFailedMessage	error_probe.WearfitBLEError
15	cancelledMessage	error_probe.WearfitBLEError
```

**code = 18 对应的 case 是 `connectTimedOut`**（domain 均为 `error_probe.WearfitBLEError`）。

补充观察：桥接的整数 code 就是 enum case 在声明顺序中的下标（0-based，按声明顺序编号），且**关联值不参与编码**——例如带 `command: UInt8?` 参数的 `commandTimedOut` 传入 `nil` 时反而得到 `0`，说明它并未按预期落在声明顺序里，而是被当作"隐式 rawValue 索引"的第 0 项，这提示该 enum 若混用了 `Message` 变体的旧 `Int` 关联值写法会导致自动编码规则改变（这里未出现,只是从行为上验证了"声明顺序 = code"这一规律，带关联值的 case 若破坏了某种一致的 case 布局可能打乱编码,需要格外注意)。
